topic: Talking with the Grocery Delivery Driver about a Swap

script.title: THE AVOCADO SWAP
script.scene_zh: 住所門口 · 調換生鮮
script.story_hook: A delivery arrives, and the avocados are rocks.
script.intro_zh: 外送送到，酪梨卻硬得像石頭，該怎麼辦？
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's doorstep scene. Listen for handy swap phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的門口場景。留意調換商品的實用說法。
script.outro: That's a grocery swap solved at the door. Play it again, echo every line.
script.outro_zh: 一樁生鮮調換就在門口圓滿解決。再撥一次，逐句大聲跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Now, let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his early twenties with messy sandy blond hair, round wire glasses, an oversized maroon college hoodie, grey sweatpants, and a lanky build
script.char_b_description: a woman in her thirties with dark hair in a tight low bun, a bright orange safety vest over a grey long sleeve tee, work gloves tucked in her pocket, and a sturdy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi there, four bags, all for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðɛɹ fɔɹ bæɡz ɔl fɔɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，四個袋子，全都是我的訂單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, the Denby order, all four bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ði ˈdɛnbi ˈɔɹdɚ ɔl fɔɹ bæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，Denby 的訂單，四個袋子，齊全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's me, though Denby's my dog's name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts mi ðoʊ ˈdɛnbiz maɪ dɔɡz neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 是我沒錯，不過，Denby 其實是我家狗狗的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'm Rosa, nice to meet you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪm ˈɹoʊz naɪs tə ˈmit ju/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我是 Rosa，很高興見到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Rosa, I'm Denny.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə ˈmit ju ˈɹoʊz aɪm ˈdɛni/
dialogue.zh: 很高興見到你，Rosa，我是 Denny。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These two are cold items, keep them up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz tu ɑɹ koʊld ˈaɪɾəmz kip ðəm ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 這兩個是冷藏品，記得要保持朝上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, the eggs and yogurt survived, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ði ɛɡz ænd ˈjoʊɡərt sɚˈvaɪvd lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 收到，雞蛋和酸奶都完好無損，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yay, sometimes my van feels like a washing machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz maɪ væn filz laɪk ə ˈwɑʃɪŋ məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，有時候我的廂型車顛得像洗衣機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I have a tiny problem, come see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ hæv ə ˈtaɪni ˈpɹɑbləm kɑm si/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我有個小麻煩，你過來看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, the avocados, rock hard, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ði ˌɑvəˈkɑdoʊz ɹɑk ˈhɑɹd lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，看這些酪梨，硬得像石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, my avocados are small rocks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ ˌɑvəˈkɑdoʊz ɑɹ smɔl ɹɑks/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我家的酪梨根本是小石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that batch was picked way too early.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæt bætʃ wʌz pɪkt weɪ tu ˈɹiəli/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那批水果採摘得太早了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what can I swap these two for?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt kən aɪ swɑp ðiz tu fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那我該把這兩顆換成什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've got kiwi, lemons, or a honeydew.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪv ɡɑt ˈkiwi ˈlɛmənz ɔɹ ə ˈhʌnidu/
dialogue.zh: 我這裡有奇異果、檸檬，還有一顆蜜瓜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, lemons, yes, I bake with them often.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˈlɛmənz jɛs aɪ beɪk wɪð ðəm ˈɔfən/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，檸檬我要，我常常拿來做點心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two lemons, is that fair for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈlɛmənz ɪz ðæt fɛɹ fɔɹ ju/
dialogue.zh: 兩顆檸檬來換，你覺得公道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, do they ever ripen, those avocados?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt du ðeɪ ˈɛvɚ ˈɹaɪpən ðoz ˌɑvəˈkɑdoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，不過那些酪梨之後會熟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, on the counter, five days maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɑn ðə ˈkaʊɾɚ faɪv deɪz ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 會熟，放在料理台上，大概五天就會軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five days, hmm, that's a long wait, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv deɪz həm ðæts ə lɔŋ weɪt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 五天，嗯，老實說等太久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try a paper bag, it speeds things up.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹaɪ ə ˈpeɪpɚ bæɡ ɪt spiːdz θɪŋz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 把它放進紙袋，可以幫它加速變熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Science from a delivery driver, impressive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪəns fɹʌm ə dɪˈlɪvəɹi ˈdɹaɪvɚ ɪmˈpɹɛsɪv/
dialogue.zh: 外送司機竟懂得這種科學，真厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten years, I know every fruit mood.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn jɪɹz aɪ noʊ ˈɛvɹi fɹut mud/
dialogue.zh: 我做這行十年，每種水果的情緒都瞞不過我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, okay, anything else missing from my list?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ oʊˈkeɪ ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ɛls ˈmɪsɪŋ fɹʌm maɪ lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，好，我單子上還有別的沒到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One sec, the cream cheese is missing.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɛk ðə krim tʃiz ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 稍等，起司好像漏了，沒有送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Missing? I need it for Sunday brunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪŋ aɪ nid ɪt fɔɹ ˈsʌndeɪ brʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 漏了？我週日早午餐正要用它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The store skipped it, I can refund that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɔɹ skɪpt ɪt aɪ kən ɹɪˈfʌnd ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 是門市漏放，我可以幫你辦退款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refund, or store credit, which one is faster?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈfʌnd ɔɹ stɔɹ ˈkɹɛdɪt wɪtʃ wʌn ɪz ˈfæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 退款跟購物金，哪一種比較快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Credit lands in your account by tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɹɛdɪt lændz ɪn jɔɹ əˈkaʊnt baɪ təˈmɑɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 購物金通常明天就會進你的帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the credit, cash travels way slower.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə ˈkɹɛdɪt kæʃ ˈtɹævəlz weɪ ˈsloʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那就選購物金，現金到帳總是比較慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, three fifty back, watch your app.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn θɹi ˈfɔɹti bæk wɑtʃ jɔɹ æp/
dialogue.zh: 處理好了，退回三塊五，留意你的應用程式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will, um, the bread got a little flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʌm ðə bɹɛd ɡɑt ə ˈlɪɾəl flæt/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。嗯，這條麵包壓扁了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw, I stacked it on top, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ aɪ stækt ɪt ɑn tɑp ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，我把它放在最上面了，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's fine, bread hates travel, we agree.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn bɹɛd heɪts ˈtɹævəl wi əˈɡɹi/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，麵包天生討厭長途旅行，我們都懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can add a free loaf next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn æd ə fɹi loʊf nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 下次訂單我可以補一條免費麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, tempting, but the flat one still works.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈtɛmpɪŋ bʌt ðə flæt wʌn stɪl wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，好誘人，可這條扁的還是能吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toast it, nobody will ever know.
dialogue.phonetic: /toʊst ɪt ˈnoʊbəˌdi wɪl ˈɛvɚ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 拿去烤一下，誰也看不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rosa, you should run this whole store.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹoʊzə ju ʃʊd ɹʌn ðɪs hoʊl stɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: Rosa，你根本可以來經營這間店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, vans first, then the big empire.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi vænz fɝst ðɛn ðə bɪɡ ˈɛmpaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 說不定會有一天吧，先靠這台貨車圓夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the total says thirty, that's odd.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðə ˈtoʊɾəl sɛz ˈθɜɹdi ðæts ɑd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，總金額看起來怪怪的，上面寫三十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's the old total, hold on.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæts ði oʊld ˈtoʊɾəl hoʊld ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那是舊的金額，等我一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is dead too, no confirmation.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz dɛd tu noʊ ˌkɑɹnfəˈʃən/
dialogue.zh: 我手機也沒電，看不到任何確認訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine died around mile number ten, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn daɪd əˈɹaʊnd maɪl ˈnʌmbɚ tɛn ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我的也是，唉，它在第十英里就沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two dead phones, what do we do now?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu dɛd foʊnz wʌt du wi du naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們兩個都沒手機，現在要怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay the right total, tip me in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ ðə raɪt ˈtoʊɾəl tɪp mi ɪn ði æp/
dialogue.zh: 很簡單，照正確的總額付款，之後在 App 裡給我小費就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tip, right, you carried four heavy bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪp ɹaɪt ju ˈkæɹid fɔɹ ˈhɛvi bæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 小費，對喔，你搬了四個超重的大袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's a gym without weights, I call it cardio.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ə dʒɪm wɪˈðaʊt weɪts aɪ kɔl ɪt ˈkɑɹdioʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這等於不用舉重器材的健身房，我稱它作有氧運動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, tip is going up, five dollars, deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɪp ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ʌp faɪv ˈdɑləɹz dil/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，小費我要加大，五美元，成交。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five is sweet, but three is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ɪz swit bʌt θɹi ɪz ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 五塊太客氣了，三塊就很足夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, three it is, did your phone wake?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil θɹi ɪt ɪz dɪd jɔɹ foʊn weɪk/
dialogue.zh: 成交，就三塊。嗯，你的手機充上電了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's alive, I can send the receipt now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz əˈlaɪv aɪ kæn sɛnd ðə ɹɪˈsit naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有電了，我現在就能把收據傳進你的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send it over, um, keep the rocks, the avocados?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ɪt ˈoʊvɚ ʌm kip ðə ɹɑks ði ˌɑvəˈkɑdoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 傳過來吧。嗯，那幾顆酪梨我留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them, they ripen, you'll thank me later.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðəm ðeɪ ˈɹaɪpən jul θæŋk mi ˈleɪɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，放兩天就會軟，你會謝我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know, these lemons smell brighter already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ ðiz ˈlɛmənz smɛl ˈbɹaɪɾɚ ɔlˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 說也奇怪，檸檬的香氣已經亮了一級。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lemons are sunshine, science, not magic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛmənz ɑɹ ˈsʌnʃaɪn ˈsaɪəns nɑt ˈmædʒɪk/
dialogue.zh: 檸檬就是陽光，這是科學，不是魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's your driver number for the review?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts jɔɹ ˈdɹaɪvɚ ˈnʌmbɚ fɔɹ ðə ɹɪˈvju/
dialogue.zh: 你的司機編號是幾號？我要寫一篇好評。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven two eight, five stars, thanks in advance.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən tu eɪt faɪv stɑɹz θæŋks ɪn ədˈvæns/
dialogue.zh: 七二八，拜託在評論裡替我留五顆星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All five stars, and the tip is set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl faɪv stɑɹz ænd ðə tɪp ɪz sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 五顆星全亮，小費我也馬上補上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I've got eleven more stops today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪv ɡɑt ɪˈlɛvən mɔɹ stɑps təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我今天還有十一站要跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go rest those arms, Rosa, thank you kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɹɛst ðoʊz ɑɹmz ˈɹoʊzə θæŋk ju ˈkaɪndli/
dialogue.zh: 快去讓手臂休息一下，Rosa，真是多謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Denny, tell Denby the human says hi.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈdɛni tɛl ˈdɛnbɪ ðə ˈhjumən sɛz haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 再見 Denny，替我跟 Denby 說一聲，人類問你好。

script.youtube_title: 【生鮮外送🥑】「我家的酪梨根本是小石頭」🍋當面調換與退款怎麼說🚚🎧｜聽完就敢開口｜60句沉浸式A2英文聽力｜Grocery Delivery Swap
script.youtube_title_en: "My Avocados Are Small Rocks" — Swapping a Grocery Delivery at the Door
script.youtube_description:
「我家的酪梨根本是小石頭」——生鮮外送到門口的瞬間，該怎麼當面調換、退款、收小費？本集是 60 句沉浸式英文聽力練習，場景就在你家的門廊前。

你會聽到：檢查紙袋與冷藏品、發現酪梨硬如石頭時如何換貨、討論熟成方法、查漏與退款或購物金的差別、手機沒電時的應變，以及如何在 App 裡加小費。整段只用 A2 初級單字，加上美國人每天的自然語感：um、well、so、ha、hmm。

聽完你就會用：What can I swap these two for、Which one is faster、Watch your app、Thanks in advance。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱，開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"My avocados are small rocks" — the groceries just landed at your door, and two of them could be used as weapons. This 60-line immersive English listening practice happens right at the doorstep with a grocery delivery driver.

You will hear: checking the cold bags, spotting rock-hard avocados, picking a swap from kiwis, lemons or honeydew, ripening tips, the missing cream cheese, refund or store credit, dead phones, and tipping in the app.

Everything stays in A2 words with the texture Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, hmm. By the end you'll own lines like What can I swap these two for and Which one is faster.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
酪梨硬得像石頭，外送司機就站在門口，你該如何禮貌地換貨？起司漏了，退款和購物金哪一個比較快？手機剛好都沒電，小費又該怎麼加？

這一集帶大家走進家門口的生鮮交接現場，從點袋子、檢查冷藏品，一路聽到挑選替代品、熟成祕技、退款購物金、小費與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🥑 換貨句：So, what can I swap these two for?
🍋 選項句：I've got kiwi, lemons, or a honeydew.
💳 退款句：Refund, or store credit, which one is faster?
📱 沒電句：My phone is dead too, no confirmation.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟外送走完門口十分鐘，下次收貨時，話自然從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你每次收貨，酪梨都剛剛好。
